items.title: Is there a presidential election in Arizona this year? Some think so

items.body: The Facebook page of the person at the helm of the Yavapai County Elections Recorder & Registration blasted out a post, advising concerned voters that this is not a presidential election. "ATTENTION VOTERS: The President is NOT on the ballot. We are receiving a lot of questions from voters who think we forgot to put that race on the ballot," read an Oct. 30, Facebook post by Yavapai County Recorder Michelle Burchill. submitted by /u/Collie_Opterous [link] [comments]
items.author: IriLine Desk
